title: Generically reduced scheme
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme]. Say that $X$ is generically reduced if, for every generic point $\eta$ [def-sc-generic-point] of an irreducible component of $X$, the local ring $\mathcal O_{X,\eta}$ is reduced (has no nonzero nilpotents), using the local-ring reducedness of [def-pc-reduced-scheme]. This imposes no reducedness condition at other points.
